text.description_html:
First Impressions Solid Brass 4-1/2 Inch Wall Mount Decorative Door Stop

These decorative solid brass door stops screw onto the baseboard casement or door bottom, to protect the door hardware and wall. Victorian styling and hand finished by the master craftsmen at First Impressions International, Satin Nickel finish.

Not just for decoration! These decorative door stops are heavy duty 3/4 inches in diameter to with stand even large solid wood doors.

Also available: Other Decorative Door Stops by First Impressions.

Specifications for First Impressions FII-NT45-US15 Decorative Door Stop

  • Length: 4-1/2"
  • Diameter: 3/4"
  • Includes Mounting Screw Stud
  • Bumper Tip: White
  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Finish: Satin Nickel

Sold Individually.
